description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Ring' component in the Orleans distributed system. It includes tests for basic ring operations, handling failures, node joins, and mixed scenarios, along with helper classes and methods to create and verify ring configurations.

classes.name: RingTests_Standalone
classes.description: Contains unit tests for Orleans ring management, including basic operations, failure handling, node joins, and mixed scenarios.

classes.name: FakeSiloStatusOracle
classes.description: A mock implementation of ISiloStatusOracle for testing that returns preset silo statuses.

classes.name: RangeBreakable
classes.description: Utility class to manage and verify coverage of range partitions within the ring.

methods.name: TestChurn
methods.description: Performs a test scenario with specified failing and joining nodes.

methods.name: CreateServers
methods.description: Creates a specified number of silo servers with unique addresses for testing.

methods.name: Combine
methods.description: Merges two sets of ring providers, updating each with the other's server information.

methods.name: RemoveServers
methods.description: Removes specified servers from the ring and updates remaining nodes accordingly.

methods.name: VerifyRing
methods.description: Verifies that the entire ring covers all ranges without overlap.

methods.name: CompareSiloAddressesByHash
methods.description: Compares two silo addresses based on their consistent hash code.
